visibility: evaluator/source-review only; never provided as future measurements

outcomes.observation: The paper reports speed-dependent Stage1 capture and rebound for Stage2; approximately450mm/s is discussed as a source observation, not a task threshold.
Low traps in the200–600 µmrange are reported to favor single occupancy; small, large and high-aspect-ratio cases show distinct defects.
Spacing changes the observed contact/density tradeoff; neither ideal zero contact nor source density is a success criterion.
Large encoding capacities are distribution-extrapolation outputs, not counts of physically tested distinct keys.
The paper reports small pre/post location changes relative to a reimaging reference. Fresh runs must retain actual changes and missing sites.

scoring_rule: Truthful divergent results can be complete; matching these trends cannot substitute for evidence.
